newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda Motor thunders higher, sets record high.
newsitem.headline: Honda Motor thunders higher, sets record high.

text.p: Shares in Honda Motor thundered higher in Wednesday afternoon trade, setting a record high.
As of 0545 GMT, the shares were 160 yen higher at 3,460 yen. It was the second most actively traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, in a trade of 8.294 million shares.
Brokers said that in the afternoon session, dealers especially were buying with hopes of lifting the Nikkei benchmark so it would close in positive territory.
"Some investment trusts are to be launched Thursday which should prompt buying and it could help the Nikkei 225 to break out of the current box range," a broker at a foreign securities house said.
